claim_and_reasoning_atoms.exact_text: Nervous and endocrine communication help coordinate these adjustments. Neurons carry rapid electrical changes along their membranes and usually communicate chemically at junctions. The two systems work together, and those timing descriptions are general patterns.

The cell body , or soma, contains the nucleus and organelles and maintains the cell's metabolism. The axon carries action potentials toward its terminal branches. For now, connect this signal with the continuous axon; Lessons 4 and 5 will explain the ion movements that produce it. An axon terminal passes a signal to another cell at a junction called a synapse.
